description: Environment and setup deliverables plus the final verification gates. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003 being in place. Appends the PROMISE_WALL_DB_URL section to .env.example (append-only), writes SETUP.md, runs the throwaway placement/profanity sanity-check, and records all outcomes in verification.md. NO git commits.
steps: Append (do NOT modify existing values) a 'Musafir Cafe Promise Wall' section to .env.example documenting PROMISE_WALL_DB_URL: a MongoDB connection string for a SEPARATE database from MONGODB_URI (may share a cluster but MUST be a distinct DB/URL), and a note that the Mongoose schema's declared indexes build automatically on first connect (no migration files).

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/SETUP.md: list the new env var PROMISE_WALL_DB_URL (separate DB isolated from main); state that the schema's declared indexes (created_at, status, (pos_x,pos_y)) ARE the migration — Mongo builds them on first connect, there is no migration-file system; that images reuse the existing Cloudinary config (lib/cloudinary.ts), folder 'musafir-cafe'; and the API endpoint groups: GET/POST /api/musafir-cafe/notes, DELETE /api/musafir-cafe/notes/:id, POST /api/musafir-cafe/notes/:id/report, POST /api/musafir-cafe/upload.

Write a tiny throwaway `node` script to sanity-check the pure functions: lib/notePlacement.ts (35% cap; the three-disjoint-20%-overlaps 60% case must be REJECTED; a placement with exactly 40 covered cells must PASS; rotatedAABB 0° identity and ~10% growth at 6°; determinism for a fixed seed) and lib/profanity.ts (clean strings, dirty whole words, Scunthorpe-type non-matches, leetspeak/diacritic variants). Record the results in .agents/tasks/musafir-cafe/verification.md, then DELETE the throwaway script.

Run `npm run build` then `npm run lint`; fix any errors surfaced across the whole feature; re-run until BOTH pass. Record the final build and lint outcomes in .agents/tasks/musafir-cafe/verification.md. Leave all files changed in the working tree — NO git commits.
acceptance_criteria: .env.example contains the appended PROMISE_WALL_DB_URL section with existing values untouched.
app/(site)/musafir-cafe/SETUP.md exists and lists the env var, the indexes-are-the-migration note, Cloudinary reuse, and the API endpoints.

.agents/tasks/musafir-cafe/verification.md records the placement/profanity sanity-check results (including the three-disjoint-20% rejection and the exactly-40-cells pass) and the final build+lint outcomes.
The throwaway sanity-check script is deleted; no test runner was added to package.json; no git commits were made.
verification: `npm run build` succeeds AND `npm run lint` reports no errors.
.agents/tasks/musafir-cafe/verification.md exists with the recorded results; `git status` shows the working tree changed but no new commits.
